name: Tebra Billing (formerly Kareo)
one_liner: Modular practice management and billing for independent practices
short_description: Tebra (formerly Kareo) provides cloud-based practice management, billing, and patient engagement software designed specifically for independent healthcare practices.
description: Tebra was formed from the 2021 merger of Kareo and PatientPop, combining Kareo's practice management and billing capabilities with PatientPop's patient acquisition tools. The platform offers modular solutions including EHR, billing and RCM, patient engagement, and marketing. For billing specifically, Tebra provides claim scrubbing, electronic claim submission, denial management, and optional managed billing services. The AI-powered Smart Staff feature automates routine administrative tasks.

company.notes: Kareo merged with PatientPop in 2021 to form Tebra

pricing.notes: Modular pricing lets practices choose only what they need. Volume discounts for larger practices.

faqs.a: Kareo merged with PatientPop in 2021 to form Tebra. The billing and practice management features are still available, now combined with PatientPop's patient acquisition and marketing tools.

faqs.q: How much does Tebra Billing cost?
faqs.a: Tebra Billing software starts at $125/month. Combined Billing + EHR is around $250/provider/month. Managed billing services (full-service RCM) use a percentage of collections model, typically 4-8%.

faqs.q: Is Tebra good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Tebra works for mental health practices but is not mental health-specific. For therapists wanting specialized features like progress note templates and session scheduling, consider TherapyNotes or SimplePractice instead.
Yes, Tebra offers a full EHR with clinical documentation, e-prescribing, patient portal, and specialty-specific templates. It can be purchased separately or bundled with billing.
